# ThemedButton

The brand's signature button: an amber hairline outline with a gold label, for every main call to action.

`FOB.ThemedButton` · Actions

## Use

```jsx
<FOB.ThemedButton>…</FOB.ThemedButton>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="FOB.ThemedButton">…</x-import>
```

## Props (ThemedButtonProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `href` | `string` | Renders an <a> when set, else a <button>. |
| `type` | `'button' \| 'submit' \| 'reset'` | Button type when no href. Default "button". |
| `arrow` | `boolean` | Trailing arrow with the hero CTA's spacing. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  |

_Also accepts: React.AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>._
